title: Module 6 game capability seed manifest
description: Declares what a lobby or ticket may configure for each game, at a pinned (gameSlug, capabilityVersion). Additive to Module 4's catalog: it never mutates or re-seeds games. Structural validation only — the seeder additionally enforces every domain invariant (allow-list membership, subset-of-catalog, rated/AI mode implications) before any database write.

manifestVersion.description: Checksummed and recorded in capability_seed_history. Re-applying the same version with different content fails closed.

gameSlug.description: Foreign key to games.slug. The game must already exist in Module 4's catalog.

capabilityVersion.description: The pin. Publishing different capabilities means publishing a NEW version row — never editing an existing one, because a lobby that pinned v1 must keep meaning what it meant at creation.

minPlayers.description: At least 2: a lobby is a multiplayer surface. A game's solo mode is reachable from the library, not from a lobby.

allowedModes.description: Must be a subset of the Module 4 catalog row's modes for the same slug.

ratedEligible.description: Requires 'ranked' in allowedModes. Rating itself is provisional until Module 10.

aiFillEligible.description: Requires 'ai' in allowedModes. Storing the request is all Module 6 does — no AI participant can be created before Module 9.

isActive.description: At most one active profile per game. Deactivating one is what makes 'capability disabled after create' a real, testable path for lobbies already pinned to it.
